carriera.title: Career
carriera.oldSave: Your saved career was from the previous version and cannot be resumed: a new one begins.
carriera.intro: Sixteen, a small club and twenty years of football ahead.
carriera.introText: Every two seasons you choose what to train and how to react to what happens. The numbers of your role tell how it went. No two careers are alike.
carriera.chooseRole: What kind of player are you
carriera.chooseRoleText: Tap the position you want to play.
carriera.chooseIdolText: The player you watched as a kid. They leave you a gift and a few stories along the way.
carriera.chooseNationText: The country you would play for.
carriera.nationNote: Highlighted nations are the ten strongest: only some careers from there get the call-up, with choices and tournaments.
carriera.topNation: One of the ten strongest national teams
carriera.chooseClubText: Three small clubs want you. You start from the bottom.
carriera.focusTitle: What you work on for the next two seasons
carriera.focusText: The more years in a row on the same skill, the more it grows. The others grow less.
carriera.restHint: Better fitness, lower injury risk, no skill pushed.

injury.medium: Muscle injury: out for {n} weeks, almost two months.
injury.severe: Serious injury: out for {n} weeks. Season compromised.

carriera.finalSeasonNote: That was the last season: it ends here.
carriera.marketText: Who wants you for next year.
carriera.endText: Retired at {age} after {seasons} seasons at {clubs} clubs.

idolHint.buffon: Total calm between the posts, even at forty.
idolHint.neuer: The keeper who plays as a sweeper.
idolHint.higuita: The scorpion kick, dribbling out of the box, a bit of madness.
idolHint.yashin: The Black Spider: always in the right place.
idolHint.maldini: Elegance and timing: he never needed to tackle.
idolHint.baresi: The captain who commanded the line.
idolHint.ramos: Headed goals in the 90th minute, and cards.
idolHint.vandijk: Strength and calm, nobody gets past.
idolHint.beckenbauer: Der Kaiser: defended and built play.
idolHint.cafu: Up and down the flank for twenty years.
idolHint.robertocarlos: An arrow on the wing and swerving free kicks.
idolHint.pirlo: The pass only he could see.
idolHint.makelele: A role is named after him.
idolHint.busquets: Always in the right place, never noticed.
idolHint.gattuso: Pure grit. Lots. Maybe too much.
idolHint.gerrard: Long shots on the nights that matter.
idolHint.lampard: The midfielder who scored like a striker.
idolHint.nedved: Fury and stamina, for ninety minutes.
idolHint.ronaldinho: The smile, the tricks, the show.
idolHint.robben: Cuts inside onto his left and shoots. Everyone knows.
idolHint.ibrahimovic: Impossible strikes and a huge personality.
idolHint.inzaghi: Lives on the edge of offside.
idolHint.batistuta: Batigol: shots that break the net.

styleHint.volante: Comes off the line, plays with the feet, makes big mistakes.
styleHint.linea: Never leaves the line and saves everything.
styleHint.rigorista: Has studied penalty takers for years. Keeps a notebook.
styleHint.marcatore: Nothing gets past the player they mark.
styleHint.costruttore: Builds from the back, always looking for the line.
styleHint.libero: Steps out with the ball when nobody expects it.
styleHint.fluidificante: Up and down the flank for ninety minutes.
styleHint.braccetto: A defender who becomes a midfielder mid-game.
styleHint.diga: Wins the ball, gives it simple.
styleHint.regista: Sees the pass three seconds before anyone else.
styleHint.incursore: Arrives in the box with nobody noticing.
styleHint.tuttocampista: Runs more than anyone and is needed everywhere.
styleHint.saltatore: One on one, always. Sometimes it works.
styleHint.rientrante: Cuts inside onto the strong foot and shoots.
styleHint.assistman: Doesn't score, makes others score. Prefers it that way.
styleHint.rapace: Waits in the box for the mistake. Never misses.
styleHint.falsonueve: Drops off, opens the space, then runs into it.
styleHint.torre: Holds it up and brings everyone forward. Wins every header.

catena.title: Chain
catena.intro: A club starts it. Name someone who played there, then another club of that player, and on it goes.
catena.rules: One appearance is enough. Clubs and players never repeat. Forty seconds a move, a wrong answer costs five seconds.
catena.party: As a group, on one phone
catena.askPlayer: A player who played for this club
catena.eliminatedNote: Time is up. The chain continues with the next player, from the same point.
catena.endNoPlayers: No other players of this club left in the catalogue: the chain ends here.
catena.endNoClubs: No other clubs of {player} left: the chain ends here.
catena.endLast: Only one player is left standing.
catena.handoffClub: Name a player who played here: {club}

impostore.title: Impostor
impostore.intro: Everyone sees the same player. Only one sees a vague clue: that’s the impostor.
impostore.how1: Pass the phone around: each person discovers their role in secret.
impostore.how2: Take turns saying a single word that makes people think of the player.
impostore.how3: The impostor doesn’t know who it is: they must work it out from your words and bluff.
impostore.how4: When you’re ready, vote who to expel. Get it wrong and the game goes on.
impostore.onlyYou: Only {name} should look at the screen.
impostore.impostorNote: You don’t know the player. Listen, then say a believable word.
impostore.innocentNote: Say a word that brings him to mind, without making it too easy for the impostor.
impostore.oneWord: One single word about the player.
impostore.voteNote: Decide together and tap a name.
impostore.wrongExpel: {name} was expelled and was not the impostor

allenatore.title: Manager
allenatore.lead: A real dugout, a real squad, a whole season to see through.
allenatore.introText: Pick a club from ten leagues with today’s players. You prepare the matches, play them minute by minute and decide in the moments that change a result. The board judges you every week.

features.squads: 198 clubs and over six thousand real players, starters and bench
features.match: Matches simulated minute by minute, with decisive calls while the game is on
features.table: League table updated after every matchday
features.events: Hundreds of incidents and decisions with consequences for your career
features.players: Ratings that rise and fall with what players do on the pitch

allenatore.saveFail: The browser has no room to save your career. Free up space or leave private browsing.

create.name: What’s your name?
create.nameText: The name the papers will print.
create.style: What football do you want to play?
create.styleText: You can change style, but the team learns it by playing it: the longer you keep it, the better it works.
create.clubText: Stars show squad strength. The stronger the squad, the more the board expects.
create.confirm: Board target: {objective} (finish {target}th or better). {players} players in the squad.

tikitaka.name: Tiki-taka
tikitaka.desc: Ball on the ground, short passes, patience. Needs good feet in midfield.

gegenpressing.name: Gegenpressing
gegenpressing.desc: Win it back the moment you lose it. Lots of high turnovers, lots of running.

contropiede.name: Counter-attack
contropiede.desc: Let them have the ball and strike at pace. Needs quick wingers and forwards.

catenaccio.name: Catenaccio
catenaccio.desc: Deep, tidy defence, tight marking, breaks. You suffer, but you concede little.

totale.name: Total football
totale.desc: Everyone attacks, everyone defends. Spectacle and risk in equal measure.

fasce.name: Wing play
fasce.desc: Width, crosses and headers. Wide players with legs and a strong target man.

verticale.name: Direct
verticale.desc: Long ball to the striker and second balls. Midfield is skipped.

equilibrio.name: Balanced
equilibrio.desc: No extremes: a compact, tidy team that adapts to the game.

quinti.name: Back three and wing-backs
quinti.desc: Three centre-backs and two wing-backs up and down. Width and numbers, but wing-backs tire.

falsonove.name: False nine
falsonove.desc: The striker drops deep and opens space for runners. Goals from anyone.

pallainattiva.name: Set pieces
pallainattiva.desc: Free kicks, corners and long throws drilled all week. Needs strong headers.

pullman.name: Park the bus
pullman.desc: Everyone behind the ball. Against stronger sides or to protect a lead.
